title: Matrix you can watch
description: A matrix formula you can watch compute: the matrices of A = XW + B stand as grids of glowing cells, the row of X sweeps down each column of W with the cells lighting in pairs, B adds in, and each result drops into A. Afterwards one column at a time keeps breathing. Only the symbols given are written.

props.eq: required, the formula, for example A = XW + B
props.terms: the vectors as {sym, text}, for example {sym: "A", text: "( a1 a2 a3 )"}
props.title: heading
